verdict_reason: mapToV4 works, but it adds a fourth copy of the serialise-and-wrap body instead of extracting it.

todos.issue: mapToV4 (lines 62-69) is the fourth copy of the same map-then-serialise-then-wrap-JsonProcessingException body as mapToV1 (35-42), mapToV2 (44-51) and mapToV3 (53-60); only the mapper and the type name in the message differ. The rule 'a serialisation failure is non-retryable, with this message' now has four homes.
todos.fix: Must: one private method owns serialising a PIMS event and turning JsonProcessingException into SqsNonRetryableException; each mapToVn only picks its event mapper. One way: private String serialise(Object pimsEvent) that names pimsEvent.getClass().getSimpleName() in the message, and mapToV4(event) returns serialise(pimsEventMapperV4.map(event)).

todos.fix: Must: the class declares no unused logger. One way: delete @Slf4j and its import.
